pet_notes: Rapi Red Hood from Goddess of Victory NIKKE, based on provided full body reference. Long warm red hair, reddish eyes, black beret with red star emblem, white blouse and red tie, black belted skirt, red jacket draped at arms, dark thigh-high boots, black gloves. Compact super-deformed two-head-tall anime sticker proportions, dignified serious friendly face. Simplified compact dark red machine gun strapped behind body, never fired, always attached. Hair clumps connected, no stray effects. Salute-style greeting, expectant palms-up request, focused gloved hand checking strapped equipment for active work, thoughtful chin-hand review. Torso and feet stay anchored for look poses, neck and eyes lead gaze with obvious chin pitch and nose direction.
